changesProposed.name: 1X Technologies

verified.name: 1X Technologies
verified.description: Norwegian-American robotics and artificial intelligence company developing general-purpose humanoid robots for home environments. The company develops bipedal robots including NEO for home use and EVE for industrial and institutional applications.
verified.notes: Company was originally founded as Halodi Robotics in 2014 and rebranded to 1X Technologies in 2022. Series A2 funding of $23.5M raised in March 2023 led by OpenAI Startup Fund. Series B funding of $100M raised in January 2024 led by EQT Ventures. Total raised figure ($123.5M) is sum of documented Series A2 and Series B rounds. September 2025 reporting indicates company was seeking $1B in additional funding. Sources [0] and [1] describe a different company (wire and cable distributor) also named 1X Technologies, not the humanoid robotics company.

verified.description: A humanoid robotics company that develops and commercially deploys Digit, a bipedal humanoid robot for warehouse and logistics automation. Digit is the first humanoid robot deployed in real commercial operations.
verified.notes: Company announced merger with Churchill Capital Corp XI to go public (Source 0, June 24, 2026). Wikipedia notes company announced rebrand to 'Agility' on March 5, 2026 (Source 2). Database entry lists Series E and $400M+ raised, but these specific figures cannot be verified from provided sources.

changesProposed.name: Nano Nuclear Energy

verified.name: NANO Nuclear Energy Inc.
verified.description: Advanced nuclear energy company developing microreactor technologies including KRONOS MMR, ZEUS, and LOKI, with subsidiaries in fuel fabrication, transportation, and space applications. Listed publicly on NASDAQ (ticker: NNE).
verified.notes: Company is publicly traded on NASDAQ under ticker NNE. Sources confirm reactor products in development include KRONOS MMR (lead technology, high-temperature gas-cooled, in NRC pre-application), ZEUS (solid core battery reactor), and LOKI MMR (space-capable, portable). Subsidiaries include Advanced Fuel Transportation Inc. (AFT), HALEU Energy Fuel Inc. (HEF), and NANO Nuclear Space Inc. (NNS). Database entry references founder 'Jay Jiang Yu' and sale of ODIN to Cambridge AtomWorks, but these claims are not supported by provided sources. Source [2] appears to be about Valar Atomics (unrelated company) and does not contain NANO Nuclear information.
